description: Days of Sikh history in Nanakshahi year 558 (14 Mar 2026 to 14 Mar 2027), as the SGPC calendar prints them. Each event has the Gregorian date at Amritsar (an SGPC day). An event with gregorianEnd runs over every day from gregorian to gregorianEnd, both included. titleEn is missing for 8 events, and the app then shows titlePa. A file holds 1 Nanakshahi year. The app loads every assets/data/sgpc_events_<year>.json it finds, so the next year is a new file and no code change. The events list is in date order.
needsReviewNote: An event with needsReview true was found only in the Jantri, read by OCR, and not in the calendar. The app skips it until a Punjabi reader has checked its title and date and removed the flag.

sources.sgpc-calendar: SGPC Nanakshahi Calendar 2026 poster, https://sgpc.net/storage/2026/03/Calender_2026-1.pdf. Source of the dates and the Punjabi titles, read from the PDF text layer, where the legacy AnmolLipi font was converted to Unicode. Public SGPC data.
sources.sgpc-jantri: SGPC Nanakshahi Jantri 2026, https://sgpc.net/storage/2026/03/JANTRI_2026-1-1.pdf. Read by OCR (Tesseract) as a second check of the calendar. 8 events exist only here and carry needsReview.
sources.janpreet-nanakshahi-jantri: English titles, matched to the Punjabi title: https://github.com/janpreet/nanakshahi-jantri (MIT). 108 events.
sources.generated: English titles of the 12 sangrand events ("Sangrand Chet" and so on) are written from the month name.
sources.review: Generated on 2026-11-03 by the .research/sikh-history-ns558 experiment. No Punjabi reader has checked the Punjabi titles yet.
